recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞明顯增生，許多晚期正染性紅母細胞（orthochromatic normoblast）成對出現、看似雙核，配合終生貧血病史，提示 CDA type II（HEMPAS）。
features: Cellular aspirate with erythroid hyperplasia dominated by late (orthochromatic) normoblasts with small dense round nuclei
Numerous erythroid precursors with two closely apposed, equal-sized nuclei (binucleate forms)
Maturing granulocytic elements (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) present without obvious excess blasts
Scattered polychromatophilic and basophilic normoblasts with deep blue cytoplasm
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia composed predominantly of late normoblasts. Many erythroid precursors are binucleate, with two similarly sized, round, condensed nuclei within a single cell. Granulocytic maturation is present and there is no increase in blasts in this field. Findings, in the context of lifelong anemia, are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II (HEMPAS).

ddx.vs: CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts with internuclear chromatin bridges and spongy heterochromatin on EM, whereas CDA II features mostly late binucleate/multinucleate normoblasts.
CDA III contains giant multinucleate erythroblasts with up to 12 nuclei rather than predominantly binucleate normal-sized late normoblasts.

MDS occurs in older adults with acquired cytopenias and multilineage dysplasia or ring sideroblasts/cytogenetic abnormalities, while CDA II is congenital with SEC23B mutation and hypoglycosylated band 3 on SDS-PAGE.
Hemolytic anemias show erythroid hyperplasia but binucleate precursors are rare and reticulocytosis is appropriate rather than inappropriately low.
